Minutes of the Monetary Policy Meeting, July 2026

Economic Developments

Japan's economy has recovered moderately, as exports and public investment have increased. Real GDP growth was projected to be around 1.0% in fiscal 2026.

Financial Developments

Financial conditions remained accommodative. Yields on long-term government bonds had declined.

Summary of the Policy Board's Discussions on Economic and Financial Developments

Some members noted that the year-on-year rate of change in the CPI was expected to be around 2.5% in fiscal 2026. Most members assessed that the upside and downside risks to economic activity were broadly balanced. One member dissented, judging that the risks to inflation were tilted to the downside.

Summary of the Policy Board's Discussions on the Conduct of Monetary Policy

The Policy Board confirmed that it would continue with monetary easing as long as necessary. Members agreed that future policy decisions would depend on the data. One member judged that the policy rate should be kept at an appropriate accommodative level.
